description: Unit test class for EmpEmergencyContactDao, testing CRUD operations, search filters, and data integrity for employee emergency contact entities within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for EmpEmergencyContactDao, covering creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and search functionalities for employee emergency contact records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including setting up the DAO instance and populating test data from fixture files.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee emergency contact and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an emergency contact with a specific sequence number and verifies correct saving.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to save an emergency contact with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of emergency contacts for a given employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific emergency contact by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of emergency contacts for an employee and verifies removal.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching emergency contacts with filters such as employee number and name.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the count of emergency contacts matching search filters.
